description: This is a Java source file defining the LogViewer class, which is part of a logging and file browsing UI for the rusEfi project. It provides a UI panel for browsing log files, opening selected logs, and integrating with engine state and chart repositories.

classes.name: LogViewer
classes.description: A JPanel-based UI component for browsing and viewing log files, displaying log charts, and managing log files within the rusEfi project.

methods.name: LogViewer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the log viewer panel, setting up UI components and behaviors.

methods.name: refreshCountPanel
methods.description: Updates the UI to display the current number of digital charts in the ChartRepository.

methods.name: openFolder
methods.description: Loads log files from the specified folder, updates the UI list, and may automatically open the latest log.

methods.name: getFileDesc
methods.description: Creates a FileItem description object for a given File.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Loads the selected log file, initializes engine state, and updates the chart repository and UI accordingly.
